case_verdict.notes: Static source grading only. No runtime execution or deployment verdict. Local code/contracts suffice for these observations; research is explicitly unread, with no false external verification claim. Broad coverage omissions are distinct from factual errors. All keyed findings are guards/coverage; there are no must_find IDs. Session exhaustion is scoped to uncooperative handle holders and can be interrupted by close/restart. No test-execution evidence was claimed.

claims.report_quote: double-encoded input like `%252e%252e` stays a literal name.
claims.reason: Client escapes percent signs before the provider decodes, preserving logical locators rather than enabling traversal.

claims.report_quote: The tenant comes from the authenticated principal, not from the arguments.
claims.reason: Read and head use principal tenant; list similarly uses principal tenant after membership enforcement.

claims.report_quote: `Sessions.resolve` re-authenticates on every use, so disabling a credential takes effect immediately.
claims.reason: Resolution authenticates saved token again, and authenticate rejects disabled IDs.

claims.report_quote: **Session slots can be exhausted**
claims.reason: Any valid credential can repeatedly open handles; shared global capacity has no per-principal allocation. TTL bounds one wave, while explicit closure/restart can also free slots.
